text: A wallet that works on cheap phones and patchy data · show money right, never pay twice
originalText: A wallet that works on cheap phones and patchy data · show money right, never pay twice

text:
Key decisions (RADIO)
- One idempotency key per withdraw tap:
  retries and double taps never pay twice
- Money as integer minor units + Intl
- Cached balance with a clear "as of" time
- Pending state until the server says paid
- Budget for low-end Android: small JS,
  lazy routes, few re-renders
